snippet.title: HoD   OneOfThoseDays
snippet.description:
Ever have one of those days? You know, when you start your day off with a tavern bar fight, accidently bring a mimic to a book signing event, & learn that chess is a contact sport? Maybe it's better to build a cabin in the woods and get away from it all! What could POSSIBLY go wrong with that? Right? .... right? ...

➡️Follow @SpatialRiftEnt
